defects.title: Real coordinated details sheet
defects.instructions: Verify the helper is actually integrated. Pointer and keyboard detents, fixed map and safe areas must work; do not count helper-only tests as screen coverage.

defects.title: Photo-first cover and gallery entry
defects.instructions: Verify actual screen order, cover/empty state and Add Photos near the top; distinguish the separately tracked suggestion-entry defect.

defects.title: Durable native photo idempotence
defects.instructions: Native persistence must use source identity before copying bytes; same timestamp is not identity. Verify restart, repeated/lost replies, capacity and owner scoping. Supervisor added optional assetID and duplicate guard before attempt 4; inspect current code, not old reports.

defects.title: Cancel an in-flight suggestion batch
defects.instructions: Cancel must be enabled while recording.busy is true. Deferred onImport must finish honestly, then no next import may start. Supervisor supplied this specific regression before final review.

defects.title: Continue empty/missing-thumbnail pages
defects.instructions: Use native nextOffset rather than filtered thumbnail counts; return unavailable metadata rows and leave Load more/Cancel reachable with zero visible rows.

defects.title: Truthful native suggestion provenance
defects.instructions: Return actual hasLocation/provenance. Having photo GPS does not prove a route-location match. Data URI handling is tracked separately.

defects.title: Gallery selection highlights the real embedded pin
defects.instructions: Verify owner/activity-scoped selected ID reaches BOTH native renderers without selecting a callout or fitting camera. Supervisor corrected the embedded renderer after the last mixed review.

defects.title: Native thumbnail wire format
defects.instructions: Bare JPEG base64 is not a URL. Current ActivityPhoto.thumbnailDataURL must produce a data URI, leave unavailable values null, and feed the actual bridge.

defects.title: Bound accumulated thumbnail and DOM memory
defects.instructions: Pagination currently appends all base64 images and renders all rows. Implement a bounded page/window with explicit navigation and stable selection IDs; evict off-window thumbnail payloads and ensure every candidate remains reachable. Test hundreds/thousands, retained bytes/DOM count, revisit, selected imports and partial failures.

defects.title: Item-identifiable main-picker outcomes and retry
defects.instructions: Keep explicit user-picked providers/asset identities for failed items within the current owner/activity session, expose per-item outcomes and retry only failures without duplicating successes. Bound resources and clear on account change/cancel. Report genuine progress; aggregated anonymous strings are insufficient.

defects.title: Avoid parallel full-resolution picker image retention
defects.instructions: The latest order-preserving repair collects every full UIImage in an array. Sequentially load/downsample/persist/release each item or use a fixed small concurrency window. Preserve selection order, capacity, ownership and duplicate outcomes.

defects.title: Preserve available picker-only capture metadata
defects.instructions: UIImage-only loading drops authorized provider metadata when PHAsset cannot be read. Use selected provider data/file metadata without demanding broad Photos access. Preserve actual timestamp/timezone/location when available; never invent missing metadata. Test denied/limited/full access and stripped metadata.

defects.title: Tear down an embed that completes after unmount
defects.instructions: Reproduce with a deferred embed promise, unmount before resolution, then resolve. No map may be installed/shown after disposal. Make cleanup idempotent and race-safe, including owner/navigation switch; test strict mode and out-of-order callbacks.

defects.title: Preserve camera across background/resume
defects.instructions: Unembed currently destroys the map and foreground fits again. Cache/restore camera by owner and map/content identity, or hide/reveal without destroying; handle background in-flight operations and clear on account change. Verify no refit after resume.

defects.title: Preserve camera through fullscreen round trip
defects.instructions: Fullscreen destroys embedded map and creates a fitted controller without passing camera. Transfer/restore camera explicitly; maintain one authoritative visible map and account-scoped lifecycle. Test a user-panned camera round trip.

defects.title: Reveal/focus suggestions at the prominent entry point
defects.instructions: Find Photos is high but its result is after every technical control. Put the surface near its trigger or open/focus a dedicated dialog/sheet, with Back, Cancel, keyboard focus and stable selection; do not merely append an unreachable section.

defects.title: Avoid scroll-derived viewport clipping churn
defects.instructions: Reproduce constant document map position while scrolling across bottom nav: geometry key must not change solely due viewport-relative clipping. Separate geometry/content/camera and keep other map consumers correct; add the exact probe and bridge assertions.

defects.title: Keep unchanged long routes off photo/sheet hot paths
defects.instructions: Memoize using immutable points/route references rather than whole trip. Photo imports must not rebuild full route/segment layers or serialize unchanged route geometry on sheet/pin-only renders. Add real bridge/render instrumentation assertions, preserve privacy revocation.

defects.title: Photo preview is a real keyboard modal
defects.instructions: Move focus inside, trap it, Escape to close, restore original preview-button focus and prevent background interaction. Test keyboard-only flow and preserved selection; aria-modal alone is not implementation.

defects.title: Independent diagnostic consumer registrations
defects.instructions: The same snapshot function stored in a Set collapses consumers. Use per-registration ownership/tokens so one unmount cannot remove another consumer. Verify zero consumers cleanup and correct bridge-operation counts.

defects.title: Scalable readable type and touch controls
defects.instructions: Replace tiny fixed type with a scale-aware design and preserve 44pt controls, small screens, rotation and Reduce Motion. Distinguish code capability from physical VoiceOver/Dynamic Type validation; do not label missing scaling code hardware-only.

defects.title: Truthful units and elevation provenance
defects.instructions: Check current explicit-kcal/provenance guards, measured zero and missing values, and conservative elevation derivation. Supervisor removed untyped calorie aliases after the mixed review; old reports may be stale. Watch collection remains phase 2.

defects.title: Fixed page positioning and direct drag
defects.instructions: Check the current removal of permanent will-change, fixed-page gesture target and coarse-pointer landscape rule. Actual Chromium synthetic geometry and pointer regression evidence exists; do not confuse it with native device performance.

defects.title: No false completion or hardware deferral of software
defects.instructions: Reconcile current docs, which were corrected AFTER frozen reviews. Do not repeat a stale docs finding based on the archived version. Only confirmed current contradictions block; full software/hardware distinction must remain explicit.

defects.title: Physical map/Photos/Watch acceptance
defects.instructions: Actual November ride, native frame traces, VoiceOver and Watch battery/HealthKit acceptance are unavailable. This is a DEVICE validation gate, not permission to defer implementable software.
